'''Burshka juice''' was a type of juice that had a bittersweet flavor. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] trader [[Sal]] once drank some burshka juice while he was having lunch with the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Renna (Rodian)|Renna]] and the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Ooorlak]].
